What's New in DockFlow 1.70

Improvements

  • Settings in Menu Bar – Settings is now accessible directly through the menu bar dropdown for quicker access.
  • Relocate Locked Dock in Menu Bar – Relocate Locked Dock is now accessible directly through the menu bar. This is useful for edge cases where a locked dock moved away.

Bug Fixes

  • Leader-Key Crash Fix – Fixed an issue where leader-key hotkey sequences caused app crashes in certain situations.
  • Show App Crash Fix – Fixed an issue where choosing "Show app" in the dropdown menu caused app crashes in some situations due to changes introduced in the previous version.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
